item.title: Getting Started
item.description:
Logging In

  1. Open Haltian Studio in your browser
  2. Enter your credentials:
Field Description Example
Organization Your organization name mycompany
Username Your email address user@company.com
Password Your account password
  1. Click Login

If login succeeds, you are taken to the main application view. If it fails, check your credentials and try again — see Troubleshooting for common login issues.

Tip

If you don’t have credentials yet, contact your organization’s Manager to create an account for you.

item.title: Site Management
item.description:
Overview

The Sites section lets you define your physical space hierarchy. This structure organizes where your devices are installed and helps you navigate your deployment by location.

The hierarchy follows this pattern:

Site (location/campus)
└── Building
 └── Floor (with optional floor plan image)
 └── Zone (room, area, or section)
Roles

All roles can browse sites, buildings, floors, and zones. Creating, editing, and deleting requires Designer or Manager role.

Sites

A site represents a physical location — a campus, office park, factory, or any top-level grouping.

item.title: Devices by Model
item.description:
Overview

The Devices by Model view lets you browse all devices in your organization grouped by their hardware model. This is useful for getting an overview of your fleet composition or finding all devices of a specific type.

Roles

All roles can browse devices by model. Editing device details requires Installer, Designer, or Manager role.

Browsing by Model

  1. Click Devices in the top navigation
  2. Click Devices by Model in the sidebar
  3. You see a list of all device models in your organization with device counts

Click a model to see all devices of that type.

item.title: Device Groups
item.description:
Overview

Device groups let you organize devices into logical collections. Unlike browsing by model (which groups by hardware type), device groups are custom-defined collections that you create for your own purposes — such as representing a room with multiple sensors, a functional system, or a maintenance batch.

For a full explanation of what device groups are and how they work with the Occupancy Data Engine, see Device Groups concept and Sensor Composition.

item.title: Devices by Keywords
item.description:
Overview

The Devices by Keywords view lets you find devices based on their assigned keyword tags. You can select one or more keywords and choose whether devices must match all selected keywords (AND) or any of them (OR).

Roles

All roles can browse devices by keywords. Managing keywords requires Designer or Manager role — see Keywords Management.

Selecting Keywords

  1. Click Devices in the top navigation
  2. Click Devices by Keywords in the sidebar
  3. You see a list of all keywords in your organization

Use the filter field to search for specific keywords by name. Toggle Show Assigned Only to show only keywords that have at least one device assigned.

item.title: Device Search
item.description:
Overview

The Search or Scan Devices page lets you quickly find specific devices by typing a name or ID, scanning a QR code, or importing a list of device IDs from a CSV file.

Roles

All roles can search for devices.

Text Search

  1. Click Devices in the top navigation
  2. Click Search or Scan Devices in the sidebar
  3. Type in the search field

The search looks across multiple device identifier fields — device name, customer label ID, vendor serial, GIAI, and other identifiers. Results appear automatically after you stop typing.

item.title: Device Details
item.description:
Overview

The Device Details view shows all information about a single device. You reach it by clicking any device in a device list — from Devices by Model, Device Search, or any other device listing.

Roles

All roles can view device details. Editing (name, keywords, images, notes) requires Installer, Designer, or Manager role.

Device Header

The top of the device details page shows summary information at a glance:

item.title: Keywords Management
item.description:
Overview

Keywords are tags you assign to devices and zones to organize and categorize them. The Manage Keywords page lets you create new keywords, rename them, replace one keyword with another, or delete keywords entirely.

Roles

This feature is available to Manager and Designer roles. It appears under the Organization tab in the top navigation. If you don’t see the Organization tab, your role doesn’t include keyword management.

Accessing Manage Keywords

  1. Click Organization in the top navigation
  2. Click Manage Keywords in the sidebar

You see a list of all keywords in your organization, with a total count in the header.

item.title: Users and Permissions
item.description:
Overview

The Users and Permissions page lets you manage who has access to your organization and what they can do. You can create new user accounts, assign roles, restrict access to specific sites, and remove users.

Roles

This feature is available to Manager role only. It appears under Organization → Users and Permissions. If you don’t see it, your role doesn’t include user management — contact your organization’s Manager.

item.title: Profile Settings
item.description:
Overview

Your profile is accessible from the account icon in the top-right corner of the application. From here you can view your account details and change your password.

Roles

All roles can view their profile and change their password.

Viewing Your Profile

Click the account icon (person icon) in the top-right corner. A dialog shows:

Field Description
Organization The organization you are logged into
Username Your email address
Role Your current role (Viewer, Installer, Designer, or Manager)
UUID Your unique user identifier

Changing Your Password

  1. Click the account icon in the top-right corner
  2. Click Change Password
  3. Enter your current password
  4. Enter your new password
  5. Click Change

The new password must meet your organization’s length requirements. A confirmation message appears when the change is successful.

item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description:
Login Issues

Can’t log in

  • Verify your organization name, username (email), and password are correct
  • Check that you are using the correct URL: https://haltian-iot-studio.eu.haltian.io
  • If you forgot your password, contact your organization’s Manager to reset it
  • Clear your browser cache and try again

“No Role” error after login

Your account exists but has no role assigned in the organization. Contact your Manager to assign you a role (Viewer, Installer, Designer, or Manager).
